description: Source code for the driver of the SF DPNS TMU (Traffic Management Unit) component, including register access functions, configuration routines, and initialization logic.

methods.name: u32 tmu_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register value with mask and shift adjustment.

methods.name: void tmu_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Read-modify-write operation for a 32-bit register.

methods.name: int is_valid_port_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks validity of a port index.

methods.name: int is_valid_queue_idx(u32 q)
methods.description: Checks validity of a queue index.

methods.name: int is_valid_sched_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 sched)
methods.description: Checks validity of a scheduler index.

methods.name: int is_valid_shaper_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 shaper)
methods.description: Checks validity of a shaper index.

methods.name: int tmu_port_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a port-specific register.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register value for a port with mask and shift.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Perform a read-modify-write on a port-specific register.

methods.name: int tmu_queue_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 queue,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a queue-specific register.

methods.name: int tmu_sched_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 sched,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a scheduler-specific register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a shaper-specific register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Read-modify-write for shaper registers.

methods.name: int tdq_ctrl_is_configurable(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks if the transmit data queue control is configurable.

methods.name: void tmu_port_queue_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures port queues with default settings.

methods.name: void tmu_port_sched_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures port schedulers.

methods.name: void tmu_port_shaper_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures port shapers.

methods.name: void _tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Per-port reset and configuration routine.

methods.name: int tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Resets and initializes TMU for all ports.

methods.name: int dpns_tmu_init(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Public function to initialize the TMU component.
